whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Neeldavid's Salon,

I noticed your salon has exceptional 4.8★ reviews with over 600 happy clients on Kankarbagh Road, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking page for new appointment inquiries.

Maine aapke salon ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp appointment booking, service menu, aur client gallery integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/neeldavids

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Neeldavid's Salon team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke salon ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp booking, mobile-first speed, and highlighting your top-rated styling services right on Kankarbagh Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?"
